subject.title: fix(gateway-client): bound websocket opening handshake waits

question: Should the existing gateway pre-auth timeout intentionally govern both the WebSocket opening request and the post-open connect-challenge phase?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically correct, but it broadens the point at which an existing setting can terminate slow connections, affecting remote proxy, TLS, or Tailscale upgrade behavior.

options.title: Share the existing budget
options.body: Accept the configured pre-auth budget for both phases because it provides one bounded connection deadline without adding another setting.

options.title: Use an internal opening default
options.body: Bound the opening request with a fixed internal timeout while keeping the public setting scoped to the connect challenge.

options.title: Request delayed-success proof
options.body: Pause merge until a slow but successful remote or simulated upgrade demonstrates acceptable behavior near the configured deadline.

recommendation.title: Share the existing budget
recommendation.body: Accept the configured pre-auth budget for both phases because it provides one bounded connection deadline without adding another setting.
